authorization_basis: Standing authorization covers as many bounded live audio runs as necessary; the user explicitly approved natural-speech workspace binding and fixed the physical self/world geometry until instructed otherwise.

level_change_from_v1.derivation: Compensate the spent v1 speech-window path-gain ranges after RMS-normalizing source excerpts; no held-out v2 capture or label informed the levels.

frozen_representation.name: prior_self_replay_template_residual_ratio
frozen_representation.self_template_source: earlier self_calibration capture with the same efference identity
frozen_representation.gain_scalar_source: current and stored aligned chirp windows
frozen_representation.threshold_rule: maximum development self-probe residual ratio plus 10 percent of the clean gap to minimum development world-only ratio

run_policy: Run all 21 trials once in implementation order. A device-open or source-start failure before playback may be retried unchanged. Once playback begins, retain the result and do not replace a failed alignment, development gap, classification, or clipping result. Any material template, normalization, source, level, or geometry change requires a new preregistration.
interpretation_rule: A full pass supports H3 for exact-efference natural-speech sensory binding after one prior replay at this fixed geometry. A failure is retained and leaves the structured-tone H3 result intact.
claim_boundary: This tests an exact commanded utterance after one prior sensory calibration, not generalized self-voice prediction, Cora-generated language, semantics, biological corollary discharge, or calibrated SPL. The episodic PCM templates are bounded to three workspace slots but are not compact learned speech representations.
